name: Onturat

items.name: Skeletal Lore
items.text: Onturat taps into the memories of the creatures whose bones make up his body. This gives him the Skeletal Lore skill, which he can use to Recall Knowledge of any kind. In addition, he can speak and understand all the languages known by the creatures whose bones make up his body (typically Common and the regional language of the skulltaker's home region). Onturat can use Skeletal Lore as the primary skill check for the Collective Memories ritual, and he can cast collective memories without secondary casters.

items.name: +1 Status to All Saves Vs. Vitality
Shard Storm
items.text:
10 feet.

A cloud of bone shards surrounds the skulltaker. When a creature moves into the emanation or begins its turn there, shard storm deals 4d6 slashing damage and 4d6 void damage to the creature, with a DC 42 basic Reflex save save.

If the creature has resistance or immunity to void damage, or an effect that protects it against death effects, or an effect that protects it against the Doomed or Drained condition, the creature must first succeed at a DC 42 Will save save or have all such benefits suppressed for 1 minute.

items.name: Bonetaker
items.text: Whenever a creature dies within 60 feet of a skulltaker, the skulltaker draws a portion of the creature's bones into its shard storm. The creature must succeed at a DC 40 Will save save or rise as a Skeletal Champion in 1d4 rounds. These skeletal champions are controlled by the skulltaker.

items.name: Splintered Ground
items.text:
The skulltaker causes splintered bones to erupt from all solid surfaces in a 100-foot emanation, except for surfaces of worked stone. A creature moving through the bones takes 10 piercing damage and 10 void damage for every 5 feet of movement. The first time each round a creature takes piercing damage from these splintered bones, it must succeed at a DC 42 Reflex save save or take a –10-foot circumstance penalty to all Speeds for 10 minutes, or a –15-foot circumstance penalty for 24 hours on a critical failure. The bones remain in place until the skulltaker uses this action again or the bones are manually removed, which takes 10 minutes for each 5-foot square.

items.name: Void Drain
items.text: When a skulltaker hits with a melee Strike, the target must succeed at a DC 42 Fortitude save save or become Drained 2 and Doomed 1.

text: Swirling down from misty peaks and through howling mountain passes like an evil wind, the vortex of bones known as a skulltaker is a terrible manifestation of the delirium and agony experienced by doomed climbers and lost trailblazers just before they met their end. In some places, a skulltaker is also known as a saxra.
